notes: Eight seed pairs per track/profile. The two target drivers are a paired team, not independent samples.
Repeated issue times and horizons share the same weather path; uncertainty uses seed-level means.
Approximate t intervals with 7 df are descriptive and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
Forecast range coverage evaluates mean future rain intensity at fixed 10-second midpoint samples; this is not probability calibration of binary rain.
Fixed compound arms intentionally disable target stops; eligibility and distance groups remain reported.
